about_the_game:
About the DLC

Hello! I’m Carbontea, the creator of The Last Train.
This DLC is a digital artbook I created for The Last Train, available in PDF format. This art book covers almost all the artistic resources in the game, including scenes, characters, UI, and more. It also contains some of my early concepts and explanations. The STEAM promotional poster included in the art book is by the artist PPMiecoo, and the English translation and editing of the text were done by Dingding & FauxFur. I am grateful to these friends for their help in completing this art book! These resources can be freely used for personal, non-commercial purposes (such as avatars, wallpapers, etc.), and their copyright belongs to the original author.
If you enjoy The Last Train, I would appreciate it if you could purchase this DLC! Your support will be a great encouragement to me ^-^

Where to Find

1.The DLC requires the base game The Last Train on Steam.
2.The DLC will be automatically downloaded and installed in steamapps folder after purchase.
3.After installation, right-click The Last Train in your Steam Library, select Manage, then click Browse Local Files. You will find the content in the folder named [ArtBook].

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our Discord channel:
detailed_description:
About downloading and using

Once you have "The Last Train" in your Steam game library, this DLC will automatically download after your purchase. Please right-click on "The Last Train" in your library, go to Manage > Browse local files, and you will find the DLC folder!
